phase_prompt.label: Phase 3: Solar Mirror
phase_prompt.summary: The Moon is full, reflecting the sun's power with perfect efficiency. It acts as a floodlight for the simulation, revealing the world in stark monochrome.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: Wide cinematic shot of the Full Moon dominating the night sky. The disc is completely filled with blinding, pure white luminance, erasing all surface detail on the moon itself—it is a hole of pure light. The glare creates anamorphic lens flares and deep, hard shadows on the terrain below. The light is cold, clinical, and unforgiving, turning the landscape into a high-contrast black and white scene. Simulation artifacts visible in the blooming light. 8k, octane render, physically correct light falloff.
